hypothesis: For most small relations some shortlex order (alphabet permutation, read left-to-right or right-to-left) yields a finite convergent completion; its irreducible words then give a rational count sequence that can be compared with the formula exactly.
methodology: For each relation and each of 2*q! shortlex orders: run bounded Knuth-Bendix; on success, independently re-verify convergence (rules decreasing, all critical pairs joinable, u and v have equal normal forms); build the Aho-Corasick DFA of the left-hand sides (s live states); compare s + k + 5 count terms with the formula (sufficient for equality of all terms); cross-check against brute-force class counts for n <= 8.
question: For which relations u <-> v can H-C01-7 be proved for ALL lengths n by a finite certificate?
